system.description:
FOLKWARDEN HEALING UTILITY WARDING
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 1 AP (material, somatic)
Range touch
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 1 minute

You press a bitter herb, seed, sliver of bark or similarly traditional protective ingredient into the target's hand, beneath their tongue or against their skin.
The first time during the duration that the target attempts a saving throw against a Disease or Poison effect, it gains a +2-status bonus to that saving throw.
Bitter Charm then ends.
The spell does not remove an existing Disease or Poison and provides no protection against an effect merely because it originates from a poisonous creature if the effect itself does not possess an appropriate trait.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Target one additional willing creature.
+2 PP: The charm may provide its bonus twice before ending.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
